headline: Recurring hydraulic leak at crane 2 is the top risk today

mood_trend.summary: Fatigue has risen for 3 days among those who checked in.

open_hazards.title_en: Slipped on hydraulic leak near deck crane

recommended_action.action: Isolate crane 2, clean the deck and fit a drip tray before cargo ops
recommended_action.why: Repeat report of oil on deck at the same crane; slip injuries are the top cause in the corpus.

fleet_context: Two sister vessels reported crane hydraulic leaks this week; one past case led to a fractured wrist.
